decls.name: ClassNumberRootDiscriminantBound

paper_span.quote: There is an absolute constant \(C_{\mathrm{class}}>0\) such that every number field \(K\)

decls.rationale: Proposition 3.7 (class-number bound): every number field satisfies \(h(K) \le \max\{2, \mathrm{rd}(K)\}^{C_{\mathrm{class}}[K:\mathbb{Q}]}\) with \(C_{\mathrm{class}}\) absolute. Proved from Mathlib (Minkowski + divisor-function count), not admitted.
